included_upstream_commits.functionality: Exclude shared hosting, CDN, source-hosting, and file-sharing domains when reducing URLhaus URL indicators to hosts.
Roll DNS tunnel subdomains into their claimed parent, keep HTTP destination domains correctly typed, and hash large captures in bounded-memory chunks.
Keep allowlisted destinations out of compromise evidence while retaining them as contextual observations.
Honor configured GeoLite2 database paths throughout attribution.
Resolve bundled analyzer data relative to the installed module rather than the caller working directory.
Consume richer handoff bundle object names and normalized network modes.
Emit process context together with accessed-object evidence.
Project GeoLite2 country and ASN fields over every destination without a downstream UMAT patch.

deployment_overlays.functionality: Add format-aware ThreatFox import, botnet-C2 scoping, typed payload hashes, tests, documentation, and a 40,000-indicator completeness gate.
Provide the complete 2026-08-16 ThreatFox snapshot as a compressed, offline, dual-digest-locked deployment asset.

validation.android_pcap_only: UMAT network-only runtime retained with host correlation disabled
validation.windows_compatibility: UMAT passes the analysis run as --case-id and maps the current WinST handoff, access events, sample identity, static-prior, object-name, process-context, and network-mode fields into the unchanged upstream schema-v1.3 CLI. The promoted runtime retains normalized Windows handoff paths and simulated destinations while adding universal GeoLite2 projection, allowlist-safe evidence, scoped ThreatFox reputation, shared-hosting suppression, parent-aware DNS-tunnel deduplication, domain/IP-safe HTTP destination typing, and bounded-memory capture hashing.
